args.body: If the existing catalogue agency handoff is still open and the pricing worksheet commits, use it to check your estimated end-to-end effort for the Novatize draft or the qualifying prospect already selected. Include acquisition, a scoped correction and operator collection time. Reuse any finished handoff and exact terms decision. description: The latest Merchant API capture did not establish a CSV acceptance rule. That limits the proposed Google feed addendum. A readable first-party rule that explicitly applies to CSV or feeds would reopen it. The existing Shopify catalogue offer can advance independently. I’m queuing Shopify’s CSV specification and a pricing worksheet that shows how much time the provisional CAD 60 fee can cover.
